name: Atlas Cloud
description: Generate images, video, audio and transcriptions with 300+ AI models.
description_zh: 用自然语言调用 300+ 个 AI 模型，生成图片、视频、音频和转写，费用记在你自己的 Atlas 账户上。
description_en: Call 300+ AI models in natural language to generate images, video, audio and transcriptions, billed to your own Atlas account.
examples_zh: 列出 Atlas Cloud 上的图片生成模型
用 seedream 生成一张 512x512 的图，内容是一只橘猫坐在窗台上
用 seedance 生成一个 5 秒的海浪日落视频
查一下我的 Atlas 账户余额
examples_en: List the image generation models on Atlas Cloud
Use seedream to generate a 512x512 image of an orange cat on a windowsill
Generate a 5-second video of ocean waves at sunset with seedance
